correctness.rationale: For every even d >=4, direct partial differentiation yields d-1 simple critical roots; exact critical-value computation gives m distinct factors and discriminant exponents 1,2. Smooth Fermat component intersections and local analytic coordinates prove d common order-d tangencies, delta and Milnor formulas. The ramification factors into d-1 distinct smooth plane sections. The t=u² intermediate has simple distinct finite branch values and S_m monodromy; the separate t=0 branch gives a single flip and normal conjugates supply all C2^m. Geometric integrality of z^d+w^d=s proves regular base change and preserves the full group. Exact symbolic tests verify cases d=4,6,8,10 but are not the general proof.
